greet.text: Captain Ilsa Varga, Imperial garrison. Thirty spears to hold a river the Compact thinks it owns.

choices.text: I have something you should see.
Tarle ran with his secrets, but I kept his ledger.
Sergeant Dace is taking double toll at the south gate. Here's his ledger.
Teach me to hold a shield line.
Somebody's robbing carts on the north road.
The camp in the woods is cleared.
Where does the ledger's trail go?
The Weirstones are quiet. The Mercy's moving to the Grieving Fields.
Goodbye.

ledger.text: She reads it twice. "Lights. Vessels. Countersigned T." She sends four men to the counting house. "The Compact will howl. Let it. Whatever's at the end of this" (she taps the last page, the circle split by three lines) "is upriver, and it isn't grain. Here, for your trouble."

choices.text: Goodbye.

ledger_late.text: "Tarle's gone downriver, and the Compact swears it never heard of him." She keeps the ledger anyway. "Paper outlives factors. That mark on the last page: I'll be writing to Ilunhall about it."

choices.text: Goodbye.

dace_report.text: "Double, every cart, initialled D." She closes the book very gently. "He'll be counting latrine buckets by nightfall. Tell Goodwife Ama her coppers are coming back."

choices.text: Goodbye.

bounty.text: "I know. A gang camps in the woods west of the road, and I've thirty spears to watch a whole river. A hundred gold to whoever clears them out."

choices.text: I'll do it.
Not now.

bounty_paid.text: "So I heard. The carters are calling you all sorts of nice things." She counts out the coins herself.

choices.text: Goodbye.

weirstones_hint.text: "The last entries don't go upriver, not at first. 'Weir-site, at the dark.' There's a ring of standing stones on the east bank, past the ford. The old folk call them the Weirstones. If something's being fed, that's where."

choices.text: Goodbye.

weirstones_report.text: She reads the letter twice. "The Grieving Fields. Ashen country, old battlefields, and one of the old sites. V. again." She folds it into her coat. "I'll write to the Fields' garrison. You, I suspect, will go yourself."

choices.text: Goodbye.
